config.trilium_autoRefreshIntervalSecond: How often (in seconds) to check for external changes to open notes and refresh them. Set to 0 to disable.
config.trilium_autoRefreshMaxConsecutive: Maximum consecutive auto-refresh failures before an open note is untracked from refresh polling.
config.trilium_autoRefreshWarnAfterFailu: Show a retry/reconnect warning after this many consecutive auto-refresh failures (and every N failures after).
config.trilium_autoRevealInTreeOnOpen.de: Automatically reveal and focus a note in the tree after opening it in an editor.
config.trilium_editor_fontSize.descripti: Font size in pixels for the CKEditor content area.
config.trilium_editor_highlightTheme.des: Theme for code block syntax highlighting in the editor.
config.trilium_editor_spellcheck.descrip: Enable the browser's built-in spellcheck in the CKEditor content area.
config.trilium_recentNotesMaxCount.descr: Maximum number of recently opened notes to show in the Recent Notes view.
config.trilium_rootNoteId.description: Note ID to use as the root of the Trilium tree view. Defaults to 'root'. Change this to scope the tree to a specific subtree (workspace / hoisting equivalent).
config.trilium_serverUrl.description: URL of the Trilium Notes server (e.g. http://localhost:8080)
